snippet.title: Lethal Honor: Order of the Apocalypse // Release Trailer
snippet.description:
#LethalHonor #RogueLite #HackAndSlash

Step into the boots of the lost and the damned, agents of a secret organization tasked with confronting the unspeakable. Armed with cold steel, arcane powers, and nothing but instinct, you’ll carve your path through the haunted biomes of Wolf Island, where every death is a revelation, and every run inches you closer to the horrifying truth.

This isn’t a power fantasy. It’s a descent into darkness, and only the worthy will return with answers.

Lethal Honor: Order of the Apocalypse is available now on STEAM, EPIC GAME STORE, GOG, PLAYSTATION 5, and XBOX X|S. It’s time to join the Order, uncover the apocalypse, and fight like hell.

STEAM - https://bit.ly/LH-STEAM
EPIC - https://bit.ly/LH-EPIC
